units: <cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 1:7">Meg. I, 7</cite> <he>אין בין … אלא פריעה ופ׳ בלבד</he> there is no legal difference between the locked up and the definite leper, except with regard to letting the hair grow wild and tearing the garments (<cite ref="Leviticus 13:45">Lev. XIII, 45</cite>). Sifra Thazr., Par. 5, ch. IX <he>וטהר מן הפריעה ומן הפ׳ וכ׳</he> ‘he is clean’ (<cite ref="Leviticus 13:34">Lev. XIII, 34</cite>), that is, he is free from the duty of &c.

<cite ref="Horayot 12b:18">Hor. 12ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 21:10">Lev. XXI, 10</cite>) <he>שאינו בפריעה ופ׳ כל עיקר</he> that he must not let his hair grow wild or tear his garments at all; a. e.
